subQuests.subQuestName: Go to Ritou to investigate the Card Snatcher

401090201.text: Whoa, look! Promo posters everywhere, from the moment you arrive in the harbor!

401090202.text: Hmm, Paimon gets more and more curious about the two inventors of this game every time we see the posters.

401090203.text: You're not the only one. There's so little information to go off of that there's all sorts of wild speculations about them.

401090204.text: Some people say that they invented the game after the God of Wisdom gave them an epiphany, while others say that they're not actually the inventors at all...

401090205.text: By the way, have you two ever read a book called King of Invokations?

401090208.text: Well, it's a story about a young boy who gets possessed by the spirit of the Crocodile King and becomes a TCG player. It's quite fascinating. I made sure to read it before coming on this trip.

401090209.text: Some people have even speculated that the author of King of Invokations is the boy who was possessed, while the true inventors of the game are the Crocodile King and Ibis King from the legends...

401090210.text: Each of these theories gets more ridiculous than the last...

401090211.text: Exactly, which is why the original author came forward to deny these rumors.

401090212.text: But that only fueled the debate further, and the book's sales skyrocketed.

401090213.text: It can't be denied that the King of Invokations novels are a major part of why Genius Invokation TCG has become so popular.

401090214.text: Just look at the venue, they're almost treating this like a national festival. I bet the book is going to sell more copies after this.

401090215.text: Heh, you can be sure that the fox lady is behind all this.

401090217.text: Yeah, Yae Miko! She's chief editor of the Yae Publishing House. Paimon can just imagine her eating some Fried Tofu as she instructs her editors to use this event to boost light novel sales.

401090218.text: Ah yes, I've been in that situation many times myself. Although in our case, the boss would be drinking coffee and talking about newspaper sales...

401090219.text: Sounds like bosses are the same everywhere...

401090301.text: The scenery in every nation is so different. This trip is really paying dividends!

401090302.text: Good thing that you're able to be so optimistic about it. It sounded like you were pretty much forced to come on this trip whether you wanted to or not...

401090303.text: Huh? Wait, is that who Paimon thinks it is? It's Ei!

401090306.text: Ah, allow Paimon to introduce you... Huh, seems like that's all Paimon's been doing these past few days...

401090307.text: Anyway, this is Charlotte. She's a journalist from Fontaine. And this is Ei, she's, uh... She's Inazuma's archon.

401090308.text: WHAT!? Y—You mean... Her Excellency, the Almighty Narukami Ogosho, God of Thunder!? Ah, h—hello! Please forgive me for not recognizing you, I...!

401090309.text: As a guest from afar, there's no need to be so formal.

401090311.text: Whew, each of your acquaintances is more impressive than the last.

401090312.text: Miko invited me here to experience the fun and festivities along with everybody else.

401090313.text: Oh, Paimon gets it. The tournament venue is full of excitement and tasty food, and Miko didn't want you to miss out.

401090314.text: I... guess I'll let you catch up for now. We can meet up later, just like last time.

401090316.text: Perhaps she felt a little intimidated by me?

401090317.text: She's probably fine. Don't worry, she didn't leave because of you, we've split up like this in the previous places we've visited, too.

401090318.text: So, how do you like Genius Invokation TCG? Paimon bets you're enjoying watching the tournament matches.

401090319.text: Well... In fact, I myself am competing in the tournament.

401090321.text: Why is that surprising? Playing cards is an ancient form of entertainment, and I was curious to see what card games are like in this day and age.

401090323.text: I advanced all the way to the semifinals.

401090324.text: The semifinals? That's amazing! So when's your next match?

401090325.text: Unfortunately, the semifinals is where my journey ended. The reason being...

401090326.text: The reason being that she lost to me. And when I say "lost," that doesn't begin to do it justice. It was quite a humiliating defeat.

401090329.text: Hehe, I'll pretend I didn't hear that.

401090330.text: I only lost because I was duped by her little tricks.

401090331.text: What's wrong with my little tricks? Trickery within the scope of the rules is better known as ingenuity. It's not my fault that some people spend all their time cooped up in Tenshukaku and never have the chance to hone their skills.

401090333.text: Huh... You're right, though. I should make an effort to get out more.

401090334.text: Many things have changed now that Inazuma is at peace. However... it seems that some people continue to fear the "divine light" just as before.

401090335.text: In some of my tournament matches, I could see my opponent's hands shaking, hesitant to play their cards. Now that I think about it, perhaps they were scared of what would happen if they defeated me...

subQuests.subQuestName: Go to the Ritou competition venue and look for Kokomi

401090501.text: Hey, compadre! And Flying Lavender Melon!

401090502.text: Grr, Bull-chucker! Don't call Paimon that in public!

401090505.text: Hahaha! What would this tournament be without Arataki "The Ultimate TCG Champion" Itto!?

401090506.text: Matter of fact, the whole Arataki Gang showed up in force. Our goal? To bring home the grand prize!

401090507.text: And as fate would have it, Boss was the only one who didn't make it out of the qualifiers.

401090508.text: H—Hey! That's not the point. It was just some bad luck, that's all. I got matched against a strong opponent in the first round!

401090509.text: Besides, it was a close match. It could have swung either way!

401090510.text: I wouldn't exactly call losing in three rounds a close match.

401090511.text: Hey, Shinobu! Cut me some slack in front of my friends, okay? Anyway, it's not like you did much better! Weren't you beaten by that fish lady... Sandy Mamma-Mia... whatever her name was?

401090512.text: Sangonomiya Kokomi? Watatsumi Island's military strategist? Yes, she beat me fair and square. I don't have a problem with that.

401090513.text: Pfft, well anyway, I've noticed something in this competition. If you wanna win big here, you need style. That's right, I'm talkin' card backs! I lost my match 'cause mah backs were wack!

401090514.text: But the style of card backs and a player's skill don't have anything to do with each other.

401090515.text: Oh, no no no no! That's where you're wrong, mini melon.

401090516.text: It's just like how the strongest Onikabuto have the brightest colors on their back. If your cards look cool, then you'll definitely draw a better hand!

401090517.text: Boss, beetle fighting and playing TCGs are completely different. In cards, you actually have to rely on your own skill.

401090518.text: Yeah, there's no use arguing with you... Why don't we let our friend here weigh in, hmm?

subQuests.subQuestName: Have a Genius Invokation TCG duel with Itto

401090601.text: Hi, Sara! We're looking for Kokomi, have you seen her anywhere?

401090602.text: I saw her exit the venue after the semifinals, but she hasn't returned since.

401090603.text: If you're looking for Her Excellency, I believe she's currently near the western shore of Ritou.

401090605.text: Hello, you two. Is there something the matter?

401090606.text: No, we just wanted to say hello to Kokomi.

401090607.text: Hmm, now that I think about it, her opponent in the finals will be a tough one to beat.

401090608.text: Who are you rooting for, Sara?

401090609.text: Up till now, the Almighty Shogun had my full support. But now that she's been eliminated from the tournament... In truth, I don't really care.

401090610.text: Paimon thought for sure that you'd be rooting for Miko.

401090611.text: I certainly would, in the past.

401090612.text: But now that the islands of Narukami and Watatsumi are on amiable terms, we're all friends.

401090613.text: Those are exactly Her Excellency's thoughts as well. The point of a game of cards between friends is to exchange skills and enjoy the game together. It's not about who wins or loses. She hopes that this spirit of friendly competition will define Inazuma going forward.

401090615.text: Her opponent is skilled in the art of deception. Even if she appears to have worry written all over her face, don't fall for it. She's likely trying to lead you into her trap.

401090616.text: It's nice to see two generals who were once enemies on the battlefield now looking out for each other.

401090617.text: Do not be mistaken. I speak only in the interests of fairness.

401090618.text: The moment I saw the name "Sangonomiya" on the list of competitors, I anticipated that she would make it into the finals to face the Almighty Shogun.

401090619.text: I've watched every one of her matches. She constantly adapts her strategy, and excels at employing rare and unusual tactics.

401090620.text: But after the Almighty Shogun's loss, I'm afraid that Lady Guuji may also have caught wind of Kokomi's strategies.

401090621.text: Oh, so you wanna make sure Kokomi's got intel on the other side, too? Wow, trust Sara to make sure everything is fair and above board.

401090622.text: Thanks for your insights, General Kujou. I will be sure to pass them along to Her Excellency.

401090624.text: The match will be starting shortly. Please let her know to get back to the venue soon.

401092501.text: Anyway, what are you two doing here?

401092502.text: Actually, we were looking for Kokomi, have you seen her around?

401092503.text: Or as Arataki "Numero Uno Idioso" so eloquently called her, "the fish lady."

401092504.text: You're one to talk, Lavender Melon...

401092505.text: Her match in the finals will be starting shortly, so she can't be far.

401092506.text: Why don't you ask Kujou Sara over there? The Tenryou Commission is in charge of managing access to the venue and maintaining order.

401092507.text: Hey, just remember that if you ever wanna play another match, you can find me anytime!

401091003.text: Surprised to see us? We came to wish you good luck in the competition!

401091004.text: So, what are you doing out here, Kokomi? Taking in the view?

401091005.text: Yes, the soothing sound of the ocean's waves do make me feel peaceful, but I actually came here hoping to see Watatsumi Island.

401091006.text: Huh? Can you really see Watatsumi Island from here? Let Paimon take a look...

401091008.text: Let's see... That must be Kannazuka, and a little further than that, there's Yashiori Island... Hmm...

401091010.text: Even on a perfectly clear day like this, you can't see Watatsumi Island from Narukami Island. Imagine trying to see it when the islands were surrounded by storms.

401091011.text: Though the islands are on peaceful terms now, the dark clouds of war still linger in some people's hearts.

401091012.text: Even when friends argue, they still need time to reconcile. Think of how much time is needed when the conflicting sides could never even see each other.

401091014.text: Oh, sorry... My mind was drifting to some more serious topics.

401091017.text: Yes, I thought you might understand.

401091018.text: Huh? What are you talking about?

401091019.text: Who wins and who loses isn't what's most important.

401091020.text: What's important is that Her Excellency came here to compete with all of Inazuma watching.

401091021.text: Yes, more people will be traveling between Watatsumi and Narukami Island from this day forward.

401091022.text: The point I hope to make is...

401091023.text: Even though we believe in different gods, we can all come together as friends by playing cards at the table. We should be willing to cooperate and assist one another in the future.

401091024.text: You could say that I'm playing cards to help dissolve enmity.

401091025.text: You're using a simple game of cards to drive major social change.

401091026.text: Yes, that's a good way to put it.

401091027.text: Besides, my passion has always been in tactics and strategy. How could I pass up the chance to play in a tournament for a strategic game like this?

401091028.text: Huh, so you have your personal reasons to play, too.

401091030.text: You should be careful of that fox lady. Even Sara warned us that she'll be a cunning opponent.

401091031.text: Yes. It seems that you're not the only one who sees this tournament as a chance to resolve our differences, Your Excellency.

401091033.text: Don't worry, Paimon. I've already thought of a variety of stratagems for the match.

401091034.text: Wow, Paimon's really looking forward to the final now.

401091035.text: And Paimon swears that she's actually gonna see it this time, no matter what! Paimon won't let herself get distracted, not even by all the tasty snacks in Inazuma!

subQuests.subQuestName: Return to the Ritou competition venue and attend the Final

401091201.text: "Inazuma's Archon Bolts Her Way to the Semifinals, Only to be Stunned by a Crafty Opponent"...

401091203.text: Lightning from Inazuma won't be able to reach me in Fontaine, right?

401091204.text: I don't think the Electro Archon would get upset over a minor thing like this.

401091205.text: Hey, what are you two chatting about?

401091206.text: Wait a sec... the real question is, how many times are we gonna run into Kirara!?

401091207.text: Talk about a coincidence, right!? What are the chances!

401091208.text: I interviewed a few people around Ritou, but no more details on the Card Snatcher, unfortunately. After that, I ran into Kirara here. We got to chatting, and then I found out that she knew you, too.

401091211.text: Paimon tells Kokomi everything that's happened recently...

401091212.text: Mm, I think I already have some insights regarding the truth of this matter.

401091214.text: But it's a little complicated, and the finals are about to start.

401091215.text: Let me put it this way, though. The key to this case...

401091218.text: Having chatted with Kirara, I was starting to think the same thing.

401091219.text: Sorry, I don't have time to explain now. We'll have to continue after the tournament's finished.

401091220.text: Just focus on your match, Kokomi.

401091221.text: Ugh... What should we do? Paimon's still trying to wrap her head around that.

401091222.text: If Kokomi was only working off of what Paimon told her, how come Paimon can't find the answer?

401091223.text: Is Paimon really as dumb as a Lavender Melon?

401091227.text: Welcome to the final round of the King of Invokations Grand Prix Inazuman regional final!

401091228.text: Our contestants are: Guuji Yae Miko of the Grand Narukami Shrine versus Sangonomiya Kokomi, Divine Priestess of the Sangonomiya Shrine!

401091229.text: Without further ado, let the final match begin!

401091231.text: Now to find out who will play first!

401091232.text: You took your time. I was starting to wonder if you got lost walking on the seabed, Miss "Sole of the Deep."

401091233.text: You must be tired after the walk back to shore. Perhaps I should let you go first?

401091235.text: I've heard that "Fried Tofu With All the Frills" gets cold quickly. If you don't serve it right away, then I'm afraid it'll become a cold, greasy mess.

401091237.text: The two play a close and thrilling game of Genius Invokation...

401091239.text: Sangonomiya Kokomi, the Divine Priestess from Watatsumi Island!

401091241.text: Whew, just seeing that kitsune youkai makes the fur on my tail stand on end.

subQuests.subQuestName: Deduce the truth with Kokomi's help

401091302.text: Huh? So the card backs we've been looking for have been right under our noses all along!?

401091303.text: But there's still one thing that doesn't quite add up.

401091304.text: Kirara picked up her package in Mondstadt before we encountered the Card Snatcher. The timing doesn't make sense.

401091305.text: I've thought about that, too. The way I see it, there's more than one thief involved.

401091306.text: So we're trailing not one, but multiple "card snatchers"?

401091307.text: Yes, the person you've been tracking most likely is one member of the group.

401091308.text: It seems the other members had already obtained the card backs and sent them together.

401091309.text: Hmm, now that I think about it, collecting all those card backs across so many nations would be near impossible for just one person.

401091310.text: But, why isn't the one we're following ever using Komaniya Express?

401091311.text: Because he's too slow. He probably missed the arranged shipment date. Well, that's how I figure it, at least.

401091312.text: From your explanation, he's only committed theft on one occasion, and there were even witnesses. After that, he's been trading or playing to collect the card backs.

401091313.text: I suspect that this person isn't a very good thief. He probably used the Mora he was given to arrange shipments with Komaniya Express as funds to use for trading.

401091314.text: Then there's another question now. Why don't the other members just keep the cards and take them back to Sumeru themselves?

401091315.text: Unless... there's a reason for them to stay...

401091316.text: Yes, this is a question I'm still grappling with now.

401091317.text: What is the thieves' objective? What kind of secret is hidden behind these card backs?

401091318.text: Unfortunately, there's no way to know without seeing one for ourselves.

401091319.text: H—Hey, don't look at me like that! I can't just open a customer's parcel!

401091320.text: If the company ever found out, I'd be fired on the spot!

401091321.text: And I don't want to go back to being a youkai in the mountains of Inazuma!

401091322.text: No, we don't want to cause you any trouble, of course.

401091323.text: At this point... Mm, maybe it would be best for you all to accompany Kirara to Sumeru.

401091324.text: Good idea! Going to the delivery location is the only lead worth following now.

401091325.text: And if the recipient really is a bad guy, then Kirara could be in danger. We should come along to make sure you're safe.

401091326.text: I can beat up bad guys.

401091327.text: Hey, I know my way around a fight, too! I haven't had a single package stolen from me since I've started this job!

401091328.text: Whenever someone picks on me thinking I'd be an easy target to take packages from, I send them running!

401091331.text: Hmm, let me think about it...

401091332.text: Alright, I'll let you come with me to the delivery point in Sumeru.

401091334.text: You have to promise that you'll hide somewhere where the customer can't see you. Who's ever heard of a group of people delivering packages?

401091336.text: Also, even if the customer is a bad guy and has stolen things, we should leave that for the local authorities to handle.

401091338.text: Next stop, Sumeru! We're really traveling all over the place this time.

401091339.text: Good luck. You'll have to tell me how everything turns out the next time we meet.

401090901.text: Well? After all I've said so far, have you arrived at the same answer as me?

401092102.text: Great! See? This is what I call a true compadre! Hahaha...

401092103.text: *sigh* Alright, I'll be the judge, then.

401092104.text: Just remember to take it easy, you two. This isn't a high-stakes match. It really doesn't matter who wins or loses.

401092105.text: Shush! Do you guys hear that? It's the cry of my cards, cheering me on in the wind!

401092201.text: I've got other things to do right now...

401092202.text: Ah, really? Alright, well, some other time then.

401092203.text: Just come find me whenever you have some time to play!

401092204.text: Actually, we were looking for Kokomi, have you seen her around?

401092205.text: Or as Arataki "Numero Uno Idioso" so eloquently called her, "the fish lady."

401092206.text: You're one to talk, Lavender Melon...

401092207.text: Her match in the finals will be starting shortly, so she can't be far.

401092208.text: Why don't you ask Kujou Sara over there? The Tenryou Commission is in charge of managing access to the venue and maintaining order.

401092209.text: ...Mkay, but don't forget about your compadre here, alright? I'll be waiting for ya!

401092301.text: Huh, I can't believe I lost.

401092302.text: And I can't believe your deck won. That takes some serious skill.

401092401.text: Hahaha! See, my theory was correct!

401092402.text: Don't let it get to you... You were using Boss's deck, after all.

401095101.text: Miko... The people of Inazuma are afraid of me...

401095102.text: And for good reason, no? A bolt of lightning from you would make even my fur stand on end.

401095103.text: You know I would never do such a thing...

401095104.text: Nor would I eat anyone! Yet, a writer of mine seems convinced that I'd turn into an evil kitsune and eat him alive if he doesn't submit his drafts on time. Honestly, where do people get these ideas?

401095105.text: ...Hmm, although to be fair, after I learned that he was afraid of me, I did start acting like I might actually eat him. Needless to say, his punctuality is now improving with each draft.

401095301.text: The Almighty Shogun herself has come to Ritou to compete in the King of Invokations Grand Prix.

401095302.text: How blessed we are. Her presence here today is sure to boost business in Ritou for a long time to come.

401095401.text: Oh, if only I'd thought ahead, I could have sponsored the King of Invokations Grand Prix with my Anahitian Blessing. This could've been the perfect promotional opportunity for me!

401095402.text: Hmm, although on second thought... Who'd wanna win a bunch of fertilizer as a prize? ...*sigh*

401095501.text: Is that the Electro Archon? You definitely don't see her every day.

401095502.text: Huh, now that I think about it, I've actually never seen the Anemo Archon, either.

401095503.text: Eh, but that doesn't matter. May the Anemo Archon continue to bring my business the winds of success.

401095601.text: Is that really the Almighty Shogun?

401095602.text: Huh... None of the figurines I sell in the shop come close to capturing her in all her glory.

401095603.text: Maybe it's time to release a new one...

401095701.text: Everybody's been playing that card game lately... Maybe I should learn how to play? *sigh* But it'd take so much mental energy, it'd probably only make me even sleepier.

401095801.text: The Almighty Shogun's TCG skills were truly amazing to witness. She beat me fair and square.

401095802.text: Times have taken a turn for the better now. I'm sure that under the Almighty Shogun's rule, brighter days lie ahead for the International Trade Association.

401096101.text: What's up, compadre! You here to play another game?

401096103.text: You've got it! This oni's ready to play all day!

401096105.text: No worries, you go do what you gotta do. I'll see ya later.

401096201.text: Hey, compadre! How about a game? You versus me!

401096203.text: *sigh* Alright, I'll be the judge, then.

401096204.text: Just remember to take it easy, you two. This isn't a high-stakes match. It really doesn't matter who wins or loses.

401096205.text: Shush! Do you guys hear that? It's the cry of my cards, cheering me on in the wind!

401096208.text: No problem! Arataki "The Ultimate TCG Champion" Itto never backs down from a challenge, I'll be waitin'.

401096301.text: I hope the final goes smoothly.

401096302.text: Everything should be fine... as long as that oni manages to avoid causing a scene.

401099904.text: (Every nation Kirara visited had a parcel sent to Sumeru...)

401099905.text: (The contents were light, and were no larger than an envelope...)

401099906.text: (The contents were probably Genius Invokation cards...)

401099907.text: (We've run into Kirara multiple times throughout our trip...)

401099908.text: (We came to Inazuma because we tracked the thief here...)

401099909.text: (The thief is likely using Komaniya Express to send packages...)

401099910.text: (Kirara's deliveries contain the treasure chest card backs!)

401099911.text: (...No, that doesn't seem to be the answer...)

401099912.text: (Hmm, there doesn't seem to be any more leads...)
